( temp article)

Vurahi is [[Areoix Lie|Areoix Lies]] second biggest economic center, only behind [[Zirohu]] in terms of annual economic output, despite having a considerably smaller population than [[Zirohu]].<ref name="gtu-output">{{cite web|url=https://www.globaltradeunion.org/database/1765/areoix-lie/metropolitan-output|title=Metropolitan economic output rankings: Areoix Lie, 1765|publisher=[[Global Trade Union]]|date=18 January 1765}}</ref> The city is also [[Acrohea]]'s third-largest economic hub. It serves as the regional financial and manufacturing center in the [[Virauzau]] province.

The city has a diverse economy that is not significantly reliant on any particular sector. While the financial sector accounts for 22% of the Virauzau's annual economic output, as of 1765, its tech sector is growing at an annual rate of 17%.<ref name="gtu-sectors">{{cite web|url=https://www.globaltradeunion.org/database/1765/vurahi/sector-composition|title=Sector composition of the Vurahi metropolitan economy, 1765|publisher=[[Global Trade Union]]|date=3 March 1765}}</ref> The city also has a substantial Green Economy, with around ₳15 billion invested into the sector in 2024 alone.

=== Income levels ===
As of June 1765, Vurahi has [[Areoix Lie]] second highest average household income , as well as the country's second lowest rate of unemployment, and strongest-performing property market.

The average annual household income in the [[Virauzau]] is the highest in [[Areoix Lie]], by a significant margin. As of June 1765, the province's average household income is ₳92,000 This amount is 15% higher than third-place [[Alvantia]], and 30% above the national average.<ref name="statsal-income">{{cite web|url=https://www.statsal.gov.al/publications/household-income-survey/1765|title=Household Income and Expenditure Survey, 1765|publisher=Statistics Areoix Lie|date=14 June 1765}}</ref>

=== Employment levels ===
unemployment has been on a constant decreasing trend nation wide in all major cities across the country in recent years, Vurahi is no exception. In 1765, it was reported that the city had added 186,000 jobs.<ref name="statsal-labour">{{cite web|url=https://www.statsal.gov.al/publications/quarterly-labour-force-survey/1765-q1|title=Quarterly Labour Force Survey, First Quarter 1765|publisher=Statistics Areoix Lie|date=29 April 1765}}</ref> [[Mayor of Vurahi|The Mayor of Vurahi]] attributed this growth to good governance and infrastructure investments, creating an attractive business environment and an increase in tourism.

The Virauzau's unemployment levels are well below the national average. Formal sector jobs in the Virauzau grew by 3.1% in 1764- 61% higher than the national average.<ref name="statsal-labour" />

=== Economic output ===
In 1760, the city's GMP of ₳1.6 trillion (US$296.29 billion) represented 71.1% of the [[Virauzau|Virauzau's]] total GRP and 9.6% of [[Areoix Lie]] total GDP; the city also accounted for 11.1% of all employed people in the country and had a citywide GDP per capita of ₳76190.4 ($14109.3).<ref name="gtu-gmp">{{cite web|url=https://www.globaltradeunion.org/database/1761/vurahi/gross-metropolitan-product|title=Gross Metropolitan Product and GDP per capita: Vurahi, 1760|publisher=[[Global Trade Union]]|date=22 September 1761}}</ref>

Since the Great Recession, the city's economic growth rate has mirrored [[Areoix Lie]] line in growth; the population growth rate for the city has remained steady at around 1% a year. Around 80% of the city's economic activity is generated by the tertiary sector of the economy with the finance, retail, real-estate, food and beverage industries being the four largest contributors to the city's economic growth rate.

Vurahi has significantly above-average economic performance amongst its Areoix Lie metropolitan peers, and numerous companies have moved employees and their headquarters to the city in recent years. In 1765, according to Statistics [[Areoix Lie]] ([[Stats AL]]), Vurahi had the second lowest unemployment rate out of all Areoix Lie cities.<ref name="statsal-cities">{{cite web|url=https://www.statsal.gov.al/publications/city-unemployment-comparison/1765|title=Comparative urban unemployment indicators, 1765|publisher=Statistics Areoix Lie|date=11 May 1765}}</ref>

=== Economic growth ===
In 1753, Vurahi was considered the most entrepreneurial city in [[Areoix Lie]], with the percentage of Vury pursuing business opportunities almost three times higher than the national average. Vury aged between 18 and 64 were 120% more likely to pursue new business, whilst in [[Zirohu]], the same demographic group was 190% more likely than the national average to pursue a new business.

With the second highest number of successful information technology companies in [[Acrohea]], Vurahi is an important centre for the industry on the continent. This includes an increasing number of companies in the space industry. Vurahi is home to over 60 fintech startups.

Growing at an annual rate of 8.5% and an estimated worth of ₳1.77 trillion in 1753, nationwide the high tech industry in Vurahi is becoming increasingly important to the city's economy.<ref name="gtu-tech">{{cite web|url=https://www.globaltradeunion.org/database/1754/areoix-lie/technology-output|title=Technology and information services output: Areoix Lie, 1753|publisher=[[Global Trade Union]]|date=7 February 1754}}</ref> A number of entrepreneurial initiatives and universities hosting technology startups such as Admyt, Xneelo, Jumo, Yoco, Aerobotics, Luno, Rain, and The Sun Exchange are located in the city.

The city has the second largest film industry in the Eastern Hemisphere generating ₳1 billion ($185,1 million) in revenue and providing an estimated 26,058 direct and 6,502 indirect jobs in 1759. Much of the industry is based out of the Vurahi Land Film Studios.

Vurahi is also claims the largest inland port in the world ( The [[Port of Vurahi]]). The annual cargo of the port in 1764 was 42 million tons. this ranks it the 7th busiest port in [[Areoix Lie]]<ref name="gtu-port">{{cite web|url=https://www.globaltradeunion.org/database/1765/ports/inland-tonnage|title=World inland port throughput, 1764|publisher=[[Global Trade Union]]|date=26 February 1765}}</ref>

As of 1764, Vurahi's labor force consists of 13.1 million workers. The largest sector in Vurahi is the professional and business services industry, which accounts for 29.61% of the city's workforce.<ref name="statsal-workforce">{{cite web|url=https://www.statsal.gov.al/publications/employment-by-industry/1764|title=Employment by industry: Vurahi metropolitan area, 1764|publisher=Statistics Areoix Lie|date=30 March 1765}}</ref>

Within this sector, the professional, scientific, and technical services industry accounts for 23.34% of the city's employment, which is the highest of any other industry.

The construction industry is the second-largest by number of employees, as it accounts for 9.29% of the city's employment. The manufacturing sector, the second largest sector, also accounts for a large part of the city's employment opportunities as it provides 18.15% of the city's employment.

In recent years, Vurahi, has become a global conference hub, and a highly desirable place to host delegates for meetings. [[The Vurahi International Convention Centre (VICC)]] in Vurahi's CBD hosts many large conferences throughout each year. The city has been increasing in popularity in this regard, and in June 1765, it was reported that Vurahi had reached 15th place globally in the International Congress and Convention Association's (ICCA) rankings of popular destinations for international association meetings.<ref name="gtu-icca">{{cite web|url=https://www.globaltradeunion.org/database/1765/conferences/icca-rankings|title=International association meetings: destination rankings, 1764|publisher=[[Global Trade Union]]|date=9 June 1765}}</ref>

The report highlighted that Vurahi hosted 145 such meetings in 1764, which comprises 35% of the total hosted across Areoix Lie that year. Vurahi also placed among the top 10 cities worldwide for average attendance per event, with an average of 717 delegates per meeting.

Virauzau's official tourism, trade, and investment promotion agency, Viz-Gro, stated that Vurahi and [[Virauzau Convention Bureau]] secured 36 new conference bids in the 1764/1765 financial year alone. These events are expected to generate ₳1.132 billion in economic impact, and attract over 87,000 delegates through to 1768.

=== Inequality ===
[[The City of Vurahi|The city of Vurahi]]'s Gini coefficient of 0.36 is lower than Areoix Lie's Gini coefficient of 0.4. This makes it more equal than the rest of the country, including any other major city, Areoix Lie's although still fairly unequal by international standards.<ref name="statsal-gini">{{cite web|url=https://www.statsal.gov.al/publications/income-distribution/1764|title=Income distribution and the Gini coefficient: Areoix Lie cities, 1764|publisher=Statistics Areoix Lie|date=20 November 1764}}</ref>

Between 1750 and 1755 the city's Gini coefficient, a measure of inequality, improved by dropping from 0.38 in 2007 to 0.36

=== Tourism ===
[[Virauzau]] is a highly important tourist region in [[Areoix Lie]]; the tourism industry accounts for 9.8% of the GDP of the province and employs 9.6% of the province's workforce.<ref name="gtu-tourism">{{cite web|url=https://www.globaltradeunion.org/database/1765/virauzau/tourism-contribution|title=Tourism contribution to provincial output: Virauzau|publisher=[[Global Trade Union]]|date=15 April 1765}}</ref> In 1754, over 23 million international tourists visited the area.<ref name="statsal-tourism">{{cite web|url=https://www.statsal.gov.al/publications/international-tourist-arrivals/1754|title=International tourist arrivals by region, 1754|publisher=Statistics Areoix Lie|date=2 March 1755}}</ref> This is driven by The regions Cuisine, night life and Historical monuments.

Vurahi is not only a popular international tourist destination in Areoix Lie, but [[Acrohea]] as a whole. This is due to its mild climate, natural setting, inland geography, and well-developed infrastructure.

The city has several well-known natural features that attract tourists, most notably [[The seat of Vurahi]], which forms a large part of the [[The seat of Vurahi Mountain National Park]] and is the back end of the City. Reaching the top of the mountain can be achieved by either hiking up or the [[Seat of Vurahi Cable car|Cable Car]].

The [[Vera & Aperdies Waterfront ( V&A Waterfront)|Vera & Aperdies Waterfront]] is a mixed-use development built on top of part of the docks of the [[Port of Vurahi]], and is the city's most-visited tourist attraction. It is also one of the city's most popular shopping venues, with several hundred shops as well as the [[Imperial Aquarium of Vurahi|Imperial Aquarium]].

The cities largest and arguably best tourist attractions are the [[3rd Imperial Palace of Vurahi|Imperial Palace]], [[Imperial Fortress of Vurahi|The Imperial Fortress]] and the [[Vurahi Imperial Gardens|Imperial Gardens]]. These and many other remnants of the empire are the main reason Vurahi is such a tourist hub.

The primary focus of Vurahi Tourism is to represent and advocate for Vurahi as an appealing tourist destination, as well as to track and report on metrics related to tourism in Vurahi (which VT does as part of its Annual Report, published online). Vurahi Tourism receives a portion of its funding from [[the City of Vurahi]] while the remainder is made up of membership fees and own-generated funds.

[[Tristan Fe Cunha]] owns and operates a lodging facility in Vurahi which charges discounted rates to [[Tristan Fa Cunha|Tristan Fa Cunha club members]]. Vurahi transport system links it to the rest of [[Areoix Lie]]; it serves as the gateway to other destinations within the province. [[The Virauzau Winelands]] and in particular the towns of [[Helio]], [[Vaarl]] and [[Emerprat]] are popular day trips from the city for sightseeing and wine tasting.

== Housing ==
Vurahi has a mix of detached homes of various sizes, townhouses, and apartments. Certain neighborhoods (especially older ones and those in the [[Western Suburbs of Vurahi|Western Suburbs]]) tend to be dominated by larger, detached houses on separate plots of land, with parks and tree-lined streets. Newer suburbs, and those in the [[Eastern Suburbs]], feature more of a mix of housing types, including low- and high-rise buildings and townhouse developments.

=== Home ownership ===
The city has for years had the second most expensive average home price in [[Areoix Lie]]. In September 1764, the average property price in Vurahi was ₳1.172 million. This was an increase of 36% from the average price of ₳854,321 in 1754 (a decade before), indicating consistently strong returns on investment for those in the Vurahi property market.<ref name="statsal-housing">{{cite web|url=https://www.statsal.gov.al/publications/residential-property-price-index/1764|title=Residential Property Price Index: Areoix Lie cities, 1764|publisher=Statistics Areoix Lie|date=28 October 1764}}</ref> Sellers often get their asking price, or within 5% of it.
